sql-lab-cross-size-brand.solution:
SELECT s.size_code, b.brand_name
FROM sizes AS s
CROSS JOIN brands AS b

sql-lab-cross-time-grid.solution:
SELECT h.hour_value, q.minute_value
FROM hours AS h
CROSS JOIN quarters AS q
ORDER BY h.hour_value, q.minute_value

sql-lab-inner-customer-orders.solution:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, od.order_id, od.product_id, od.quantity
FROM customers AS c
INNER JOIN order_detail AS od
    ON c.customer_id = od.customer_id

sql-lab-inner-multi-key.solution:
SELECT a.store_id, a.product_id, a.amount, t.target_amount
FROM actual_sales AS a
INNER JOIN product_targets AS t
    ON a.store_id = t.store_id
   AND a.product_id = t.product_id

sql-lab-left-preserve-customers.solution:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, od.order_id, od.product_id, od.quantity
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN order_detail AS od
    ON c.customer_id = od.customer_id

sql-lab-left-find-missing-universe.solution:
SELECT s.sale_id, s.product_id, pc.category_id, cu.universe_id
FROM sales AS s
LEFT JOIN product_category AS pc
    ON s.product_id = pc.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_universe AS cu
    ON pc.category_id = cu.category_id
WHERE cu.universe_id IS NULL

sql-lab-left-filter-placement.solution:
SELECT c.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_date
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
   AND o.status = 'COMPLETED'
   AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
   AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'

sql-lab-full-reconcile.solution:
SELECT COALESCE(s.customer_id, t.customer_id) AS customer_id,
    CASE
        WHEN s.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'TARGET_ONLY'
        WHEN t.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'SOURCE_ONLY'
        ELSE 'MATCHED'
    END AS reconciliation_status
FROM source_customers AS s
FULL OUTER JOIN target_customers AS t
    ON s.customer_id = t.customer_id

sql-lab-self-manager.solution:
SELECT e.employee_name, m.employee_name AS manager_name
FROM employees AS e
LEFT JOIN employees AS m
    ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id

sql-lab-self-consecutive-orders.solution:
SELECT a.customer_id, a.order_id AS first_order, a.order_date AS first_order_date,
       b.order_id AS second_order, b.order_date AS second_order_date
FROM sales_orders AS a
INNER JOIN sales_orders AS b
    ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id
   AND b.order_date = a.order_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY

sql-lab-groupby-basket.solution:
SELECT customer_id, AVG(amount) AS average_basket_amount
FROM sales
GROUP BY customer_id

sql-lab-groupby-having.solution:
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS sale_count, AVG(sale_value) AS avg_sale_value
FROM property_sales
GROUP BY city
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
   AND AVG(sale_value) < 250000

sql-lab-groupby-above-global.solution:
SELECT customer_id, AVG(amount) AS customer_avg
FROM sales
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING AVG(amount) > (
    SELECT AVG(amount)
    FROM sales
)

sql-lab-case-raises.solution:
SELECT employee_name, department, wage,
    CASE
        WHEN department = 'SALES' THEN wage * 1.10
        WHEN department = 'HR' THEN wage * 1.05
        WHEN department = 'IT' THEN wage * 1.03
        ELSE wage
    END AS wage_after_raise
FROM employees

sql-lab-case-inside-sum.solution:
SELECT discount_code,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN discount_code = 'DISCOUNT10' THEN quantity * price_per_unit * 0.90
            WHEN discount_code = 'DISCOUNT20' THEN quantity * price_per_unit * 0.80
            ELSE quantity * price_per_unit
        END
    ) AS total_revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY discount_code

sql-lab-case-salary-bands.solution:
WITH banded AS (
    SELECT department, wage,
        CASE
            WHEN wage <= 50000 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN wage < 90000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS salary_band
    FROM employees
)
SELECT department, salary_band, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, AVG(wage) AS average_wage
FROM banded
GROUP BY department, salary_band

sql-lab-case-football-wins.solution:
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN home_team = 'Lille' AND home_goals > away_goals THEN 1 END) AS home_wins,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN away_team = 'Lille' AND away_goals > home_goals THEN 1 END) AS away_wins
FROM matches
WHERE division = 'L1'

sql-lab-grouping-two-sets.solution:
SELECT contract_type, act_type, SUM(amount_reimbursed) AS total_reimbursed
FROM reimbursements
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (contract_type),
    (act_type)
)

sql-lab-grouping-label-subtotals.solution:
SELECT year_value,
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(region) = 1 THEN 'ALL REGIONS' ELSE region END AS region_label,
    SUM(population) AS population
FROM regional_population
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (year_value, region),
    (year_value)
)

sql-lab-grouping-rollup.solution:
SELECT contract_type, act_type, SUM(amount_reimbursed) AS total_reimbursed
FROM reimbursements
GROUP BY ROLLUP (contract_type, act_type)

sql-lab-grouping-cube.solution:
SELECT contract_type, act_type, SUM(amount_reimbursed) AS total_reimbursed
FROM reimbursements
GROUP BY CUBE (contract_type, act_type)

sql-lab-window-running-total.solution:
SELECT date_value, visitors_count,
    SUM(visitors_count) OVER (
        ORDER BY date_value
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_visitors
FROM sensor_daily

sql-lab-window-centered-average.solution:
SELECT date_value, daily_sales,
    AVG(daily_sales) OVER (
        ORDER BY date_value
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS moving_average
FROM store_daily_sales

sql-lab-window-dept-average.solution:
SELECT employee_name, department, wage,
    AVG(wage) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS department_avg_wage
FROM employees

sql-lab-window-top-earner-flag.solution:
WITH x AS (
    SELECT *, MAX(wage) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS department_max_wage
    FROM employees
)
SELECT employee_name, department, wage, department_max_wage,
    CASE WHEN wage = department_max_wage THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_top_earner
FROM x

sql-lab-window-second-highest.solution:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY wage DESC) AS wage_rank
    FROM employees
)
SELECT employee_name, department, wage
FROM ranked
WHERE wage_rank = 2

sql-lab-window-pct-change.solution:
WITH x AS (
    SELECT *, LAG(visitors_count) OVER (PARTITION BY weekday_number ORDER BY date_value) AS previous_visitors
    FROM sensor_daily
)
SELECT date_value, weekday_number, visitors_count, previous_visitors,
    (visitors_count - previous_visitors) * 1.0 / NULLIF(previous_visitors, 0) AS pct_change
FROM x

sql-lab-window-row-number-dept.solution:
SELECT employee_name, department, wage,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY wage DESC, employee_name) AS wage_row_number
FROM employees

sql-lab-window-dense-rank.solution:
SELECT employee_name, sex, wage,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sex ORDER BY wage DESC) AS wage_rank
FROM employees

sql-lab-window-rows-vs-range.solution:
SELECT event_id, event_date, amount,
    SUM(amount) OVER (
        ORDER BY event_date, event_id
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_total
FROM sales_events

sql-lab-cross-retail-grid.solution:
SELECT s.store_id, m.market_id, mo.month_id, w.weekday_id, q.quarter_id
FROM stores AS s
CROSS JOIN markets AS m
CROSS JOIN months AS mo
CROSS JOIN weekdays AS w
CROSS JOIN quarters AS q

sql-lab-inner-add-products.solution:
SELECT co.order_id, co.customer_id, co.product_id, co.quantity, p.product_name, p.unit_price
FROM customer_orders AS co
INNER JOIN products AS p
    ON co.product_id = p.product_id

sql-lab-inner-retail-chain.solution:
SELECT s.sale_id, s.product_id, pc.category_id, cu.universe_id
FROM sales AS s
INNER JOIN product_category AS pc
    ON s.product_id = pc.product_id
INNER JOIN category_universe AS cu
    ON pc.category_id = cu.category_id

sql-lab-inner-constant-key.solution:
SELECT b.beverage, f.food
FROM beverages AS b
CROSS JOIN food_items AS f

sql-lab-left-product-enrichment.solution:
SELECT co.order_id, co.product_id, co.quantity, p.product_name
FROM customer_orders AS co
LEFT JOIN products AS p
    ON co.product_id = p.product_id

sql-lab-full-products.solution:
SELECT sp.store_id, COALESCE(sp.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id, p.product_name
FROM store_products AS sp
FULL OUTER JOIN products AS p
    ON sp.product_id = p.product_id

sql-lab-self-meetings.solution:
SELECT a.meeting_id, b.person_name AS colleague, a.duration_minutes
FROM meeting_participants AS a
INNER JOIN meeting_participants AS b
    ON a.meeting_id = b.meeting_id
WHERE a.person_name = 'Benjamin'
  AND b.person_name <> 'Benjamin'

sql-lab-groupby-neighborhood.solution:
SELECT neighborhood, AVG(price) AS average_price
FROM property_sales
GROUP BY neighborhood

sql-lab-groupby-city.solution:
SELECT city, CAST(AVG(sale_value) AS INTEGER) AS avg_sale_value
FROM property_sales
GROUP BY city

sql-lab-groupby-above-global-cte.solution:
WITH global_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM sales
)
SELECT s.customer_id, AVG(s.amount) AS customer_avg
FROM sales AS s
CROSS JOIN global_avg AS g
GROUP BY s.customer_id, g.avg_amount
HAVING AVG(s.amount) > g.avg_amount

sql-lab-groupby-meeting-average.solution:
WITH benjamin_meetings AS (
    SELECT a.meeting_id, b.person_name AS colleague, a.duration_minutes
    FROM meeting_participants AS a
    INNER JOIN meeting_participants AS b
        ON a.meeting_id = b.meeting_id
    WHERE a.person_name = 'Benjamin'
      AND b.person_name <> 'Benjamin'
)
SELECT colleague, AVG(duration_minutes) AS avg_meeting_duration
FROM benjamin_meetings
GROUP BY colleague

sql-lab-case-discount-cte.solution:
WITH priced AS (
    SELECT discount_code,
        CASE
            WHEN discount_code = 'DISCOUNT10' THEN quantity * price_per_unit * 0.90
            WHEN discount_code = 'DISCOUNT20' THEN quantity * price_per_unit * 0.80
            ELSE quantity * price_per_unit
        END AS revenue_after_discount
    FROM sales
)
SELECT discount_code, SUM(revenue_after_discount) AS total_revenue
FROM priced
GROUP BY discount_code

sql-lab-grouping-contract.solution:
SELECT contract_type, SUM(amount_reimbursed) AS total_reimbursed
FROM reimbursements
GROUP BY contract_type

sql-lab-grouping-contract-act.solution:
SELECT contract_type, act_type, SUM(amount_reimbursed) AS total_reimbursed
FROM reimbursements
GROUP BY contract_type, act_type

sql-lab-grouping-union.solution:
SELECT contract_type AS typology, SUM(amount_reimbursed) AS total_reimbursed
FROM reimbursements
GROUP BY contract_type

UNION ALL

SELECT act_type AS typology, SUM(amount_reimbursed) AS total_reimbursed
FROM reimbursements
GROUP BY act_type

sql-lab-grouping-region-year.solution:
SELECT year_value, region, SUM(population) AS population
FROM regional_population
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (year_value, region),
    (year_value)
)

sql-lab-grouping-multilevel-rollup.solution:
SELECT contract_type, act_type, age_group, sex, year_value, SUM(amount_reimbursed) AS total_reimbursed
FROM reimbursements
GROUP BY ROLLUP (
    contract_type,
    act_type,
    age_group,
    sex,
    year_value
)

sql-lab-grouping-store-share.solution:
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT store_id, product_name, SUM(amount) AS amount
    FROM sales
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (store_id, product_name),
        (store_id)
    )
), store_rollup AS (
    SELECT store_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN product_name = 'Red Bull' THEN amount END) AS red_bull_sales,
        MAX(CASE WHEN product_name IS NULL THEN amount END) AS store_sales
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT store_id, red_bull_sales, store_sales,
    red_bull_sales * 1.0 / NULLIF(store_sales, 0) AS red_bull_share
FROM store_rollup

sql-lab-window-sum-over.solution:
SELECT date_value, visitors_count,
    SUM(visitors_count) OVER () AS total_visitors
FROM sensor_daily

sql-lab-window-progressive-average.solution:
SELECT date_value, visitors_count,
    AVG(visitors_count) OVER (
        ORDER BY date_value
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS avg_visitors_to_date
FROM sensor_daily

sql-lab-window-seven-row-average.solution:
SELECT date_value, visitors_count,
    AVG(visitors_count) OVER (
        ORDER BY date_value
        ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS seven_day_avg
FROM sensor_daily

sql-lab-window-verify-average.solution:
WITH w AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(visitors_count) OVER (ORDER BY date_value ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_sum,
        COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY date_value ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_count,
        AVG(visitors_count) OVER (ORDER BY date_value ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_avg
    FROM sensor_daily
)
SELECT date_value, visitors_count, window_sum, window_count, window_avg,
    window_sum * 1.0 / NULLIF(window_count, 0) AS manual_avg
FROM w

sql-lab-window-dept-max.solution:
SELECT employee_name, department, wage,
    MAX(wage) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS department_max_wage
FROM employees

sql-lab-window-weekday-partition.solution:
SELECT date_value, weekday_number, visitors_count,
    AVG(visitors_count) OVER (
        PARTITION BY weekday_number
        ORDER BY date_value
        ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS same_weekday_avg
FROM sensor_daily

sql-lab-window-lag.solution:
SELECT date_value, weekday_number, visitors_count,
    LAG(visitors_count) OVER (
        PARTITION BY weekday_number
        ORDER BY date_value
    ) AS previous_same_weekday_visitors
FROM sensor_daily

sql-lab-window-row-number-sex.solution:
SELECT employee_name, sex, wage,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sex ORDER BY wage DESC, employee_name) AS wage_row_number
FROM employees

sql-lab-window-sensor-running-avg.solution:
SELECT sensor_id, date_value, visitors_count,
    AVG(visitors_count) OVER (
        PARTITION BY sensor_id
        ORDER BY date_value
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_avg_visitors
FROM sensor_daily

sql-lab-window-sensor-weekday.solution:
SELECT sensor_id, weekday_number, date_value, visitors_count,
    AVG(visitors_count) OVER (
        PARTITION BY sensor_id, weekday_number
        ORDER BY date_value
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_avg_visitors
FROM sensor_daily

sql-lab-window-updated-ranking.solution:
WITH moving AS (
    SELECT *,
        AVG(visitors_count) OVER (
            PARTITION BY sensor_id, weekday_number
            ORDER BY date_value
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_avg_visitors
    FROM sensor_daily
)
SELECT sensor_id, weekday_number, date_value, visitors_count, running_avg_visitors,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY date_value ORDER BY running_avg_visitors DESC) AS sensor_rank
FROM moving

sql-lab-window-top-one.solution:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY wage DESC, employee_name) AS rn
    FROM employees
)
SELECT employee_name, department, wage
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
